answer: Mechanism: Trace-Collision Attestation. Each agent derives identity from a TPM-backed execution fingerprint plus periodic timing/IO trace digest. At each comet beacon (a summit checkpoint), it publishes a quill-signed trace digest to gossip auditors. A clone shares the key but diverges in timing/cache/IO, so auditors receive conflicting signed digests for one identity and flag duplication. Cost: attacker must keep clones bit-identical across timing/IO or emulate one trace while suppressing audits; first collision exposes the set.
